item.title: Captures: MP thread delete, MP list past the last page, multi-quote cookie, BBCode and emoji (#169, #114, #333, #334, #172, #171)
item.body:
Closes #169 Closes #114 Closes #334 Closes #172 Closes #171 Refs #333 (the "destiné" answer for the storage thread is captured; the storage row on page 2 or later is not reachable with the kit's accounts, see below) Claim: mac/capture-batch **Problem.** LOT-094 (#186, MP thread delete), LOT-097 (#189, BBCode preview), LOT-049 (#75, quote engine), LOT-096/LOT-151 (emoji) and LOT-038's pager walk were waiting on page states nobody had captured (LESSONS 35-36). **What was sent to HFR (run 9, 2026-11-02, 28 requests, private MP between the operator's two accounts, one attempt per state, approved on #337).** user2 opened a throwaway thread `fixture-test-2` to user1 holding every composer toolbar tag (`W61`); user1 answered with BMP emoji (`W62`); user2 sent a multi-quote reply with the selection cookie as the site's `forum2.js` writes it (`R95g`, `W63`); user2 deleted the thread with legacy's `manageaction.php` body, first with a wrong `hash_check` (`W64x`), then with the right one (`W64`); user1 deleted it too (`W65`). Nothing of the thread is left on HFR. Log: every write with its UTC time is on its issue. **What the captures settle** (MANIFEST run 9, HFR-PROTOCOL §3.1, §4, §6b, LOT-038, §7): - MP thread delete: wrong token → the 99-byte text of `W17b`, nothing deleted; success → link-less `.hop` "Action effectuée avec succès", refresh to the MP list. The delete only removes the thread from the deleting account's list (`R95j`, `R95k`, `R96c`, `R96d`). - MP list past the last page (`R96a`): 200, no `.hop`, an empty list page whose pager lists 1-7 and links "Page Précédente". - Storage thread of another account (`R96b`): the "pas destiné" `.hop` legacy's `parseMPStorage` checks. - Multi-quote cookie: the site writes it host-only (`forum.hardware.fr`), `escape()`d; HFR reads both forms; after every reply HFR sends `…=deleted; expires=1970; path=/` without `Domain` (`W62`, `W63`), so a `.hardware.fr` selection is not cleared by HFR. - BBCode: the edit form gives back the source byte for byte; `POST /apercu.php` renders the same HTML as the thread (whitespace and the opening `

` aside); `[color]`, `[list]` and an unclosed tag are not rendered. - BMP emoji and U+FE0F are kept unchanged and rendered as text. **Why the rendered pairs are previews.** `--private` replaces MP bodies on the thread pages, so the render is published as HFR's own `/apercu.php` answer; the equality with the thread page was measured on the raw pages, which are not published. **Tooling.** `flows.py form --cookie` sends an extra cookie with the POST only (a browser posting a multi-quote reply still carries it). Test `test_form_temp_cookie_sent_with_post_only` fails without the change. **Checks.** `publish.py` (17 written, 0 refused), `anonymize.py check --corpus` (all clean) and `check --config`; independent leak check by a separate Sonnet agent: **PASS** (names from the raw member positions, ids, hash_check and cookie values, passwords, private subjects and bodies searched in plain, escaped, URL-encoded and slug forms; only false positives, explained in its report). Legacy oracles: LOT-002 `R95j`, `R95k`, `R96a` (`mp`), LOT-003 `R96c`, `R96d` (`topic`), LOT-004 `R95c`, `R95f` (edit form), `R95g` (quote form), `W61`-`W63` (`response`, all `success`), `R96b` (`mpstorage-page`: the "destiné" branch, its alert and find GET); every existing oracle regenerated unchanged. No oracle for `W64x`, `W64`, `W65` (legacy only checks the HTTP status of the delete, `MPListView.swift:155-163`) nor for the `/apercu.php` answers (legacy has no preview). **Not captured.** The MPStorage row on page 2 or later (#333): user1's row is row 42 of 50 on page 1 (`R95k`), ~9 newer conversations would be needed at one new MP per account per hour. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_014QH2CFA3L8YfjJi4AdxgzW ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Tests** * Expanded coverage for private-message creation, editing, replies, previews, multi-quote behavior, and thread deletion. * Added cases for BBCode, emoji, invalid deletion tokens, pagination beyond the last page, and messages viewed from different accounts. * **Documentation** * Updated the protocol reference with observed private-message deletion, preview, cookie, emoji, and pagination behavior. * **Chores** * Added support for temporary cookies on form submissions, limited to the POST request.

**Skip the jar save while temporary cookies are installed.** `Client.request` saves the jar at `tooling/fixtures/flows.py:163`. `cmd_form` installs the temporary cookies before that call and removes them only in its `finally` block. A non-redirecting POST therefore writes the jar while the temporary cookie is still present. If the process is terminated uncatchably, such as with SIGKILL or during a power loss, between that save and the `finally` block, the cookie stays in the account jar. Later captures for that account then send it, and a later `--cookie` with the same name is refused as already held. Redirect handling is not affected. The cookie is dropped before each followed hop, so the save at line 163 does not write it. Add a `save` flag to `request` and skip the save from `cmd_form`. The existing `finally` block still saves the jar after cleanup. Other callers keep the default behavior.
